title: Prazosin and doxazosin for alcohol use disorder: ClinicalTrials.gov posted results only
intro: Randomized trials of prazosin or doxazosin against placebo with a posted drinking outcome after at least 4 weeks of treatment, from query.cond=alcohol&query.intr=prazosin OR doxazosin (21 records, 11 with results, 2026-10-15). Inclusion, the outcome hierarchy and the general/comorbid (current PTSD required) classification were committed before any outcome data were read (alpha1-blocker-aud-prereg-4-2026-10-15.md). Outcome: the posted heavy-drinking measure at the last on-treatment time point where posted, otherwise drinks per drinking day or per week, otherwise drinking days, otherwise abstinence. Read 2026-10-15. Dropped on reading: NCT02226367 (the only posted outcome is the Penn Alcohol Craving Scale, not a drinking outcome). NCT02989493 posts only the number of participants with any heavy drinking day, used as a binary heavy-drinking outcome. NCT00585780 is posted by withdrawal stratum; both prazosin strata are combined against both placebo strata as pre-registered.

studies.label: Prazosin 16 mg/day, 12 weeks
studies.measure: % heavy drinking days, final medication week
studies.note: analysed: participants who finished titration, 40 per arm (48 and 44 randomized). Baselines 71.8 and 66.5

studies.label: Doxazosin, target 8 mg, 8 weeks
studies.outcome: Number of Participants Reporting Any Heavy Drinking Days
studies.note: the only posted drinking outcome; the other primary outcome is startle potentiation

studies.label: Prazosin 16 mg/day, 6 weeks
studies.outcome: Number of Standard Alcoholic Drinks Consumed Per Week
studies.note: no heavy-drinking outcome posted; the later of the two posted windows (weeks 4-6) used. Weeks 2-4 point the other way (13.65 vs 14.55)

studies.label: Prazosin 16 mg/day by alcohol withdrawal stratum, 12 weeks
studies.note: posted by withdrawal stratum (high: 8.2 vs 27.11; low: 31.29 vs 7.32); strata combined. The published paper (PMID 33207935) reports benefit only in the high-withdrawal stratum

studies.note: 2 x 2 factorial; prazosin arms (with naltrexone or its placebo) vs the others. Prazosin + placebo vs placebo + placebo alone is exploratory E3
